tools.name: agent-desktop.setup
tools.description: Write the agent-desktop unit. Does not start a sandbox.

tools.name: agent-desktop.check
tools.description: Check the agent-desktop unit recorded by agent-desktop.setup.

tools.name: agent-desktop.uninstall
tools.description: Delete the agent-desktop folder under the self-hosted home. That folder holds the install, config, and state agent-desktop.setup wrote.
